STEP 1 |
Log in to the web interface on the firewall.
STEP 2 |
Select Use Single Sign-On and Continue.
STEP 3 |
Enter your login credentials on the Duo Access Gateway login page.
STEP 4 |
Select an authentication method (push notification, phone call, or passcode entry).
When you authenticate successfully, you will be redirected to the firewall web interface.
